Nasturtium Tom Thumb - 2x Plug Plants - Compact, Low-Maintenance, Edible

Nasturtium Tom Thumb Plug Plants - Compact, Edible, Easy to Grow

Grows to about 30cm (12 inches) tall - great for small spaces.

Bright, single flowers in mixed colors.

Leaves and flowers are edible - use in salads or as a garnish.

Low maintenance - grows well in poor soil and is easy to care for.

Attracts bees and butterflies.

Suitable for borders, containers, or hanging baskets.

Care Instructions:

Needs full sun for best flowering.

Plant in poor, well-drained soil.

Space plants 6-12 inches (15-30cm) apart.

Water regularly, especially in dry weather, but don't overwater.

No need to fertilize - too much feed means fewer flowers.

Remove dead flowers to encourage more blooms.

Ready to plant on arrival. Perfect for adding color and interest to your garden with minimal effort!
